Eh, this plot is not even mine, I am renting it, so I cannot spend too much money on it. I have no schooling and I farm the way my father taught me. In Tabora here the rains are not always good, and I have no pump or river close by, so irrigation is out of the question. I will put some manure from my few goats and chickens, use the seeds I saved from last season, and my wife and grown children will help me with the weeding. If the weeds get too much near harvest I may call one or two young men from the village to help for a few days.
